subject: Comprehensive Litigation Reporting and Independent Review
overview: The Council approved a resolution requesting a comprehensive report and an independent review of city litigation and legal expenses following a significant increase in labor disputes. The body also approved several infrastructure grants of location and requested an implementation plan for a municipal home-sharing program.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions recognizing Black History Month, Lunar New Year, Ramadan, and Lent, as well as National Therapy Animal Day.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved various committee reports including discussions on ambulance services, the city clerk position, law enforcement transparency, and ward meetings.

items.title: Grant of Location: 57 Swan Street
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to the next regular meeting to await a representative from National Grid.

items.title: Grant of Location: Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a gas main replacement from 336 to 436 Riverside Avenue to accommodate MWRA slip-lining work, following discussion regarding construction schedules and curb-to-curb repaving.

items.title: Grant of Location: Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved manhole and conduit installation on Boston Avenue to support an all-electric Tufts University expansion, with stipulations to minimize night-work noise for residents.

items.title: Business Licenses
items.summary: Approved a license transfer for Lighthouse Cafe and an amended hours of operation for Coldstone Creamery.

items.title: Comprehensive Litigation and Labor Relations Reporting
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a comprehensive report on all litigation since 2019, quarterly updates, and an independent review of the city’s risk management and legal practices due to a spike in unfair labor practice charges. The resolution includes requests for cost breakdowns, insurance premium impacts, and an audit of outside legal counsel expenditures.

items.title: Infrastructure and Utility Communication
items.summary: Approved requests for DPW briefings on major roadway infrastructure projects and enhanced public notification requirements regarding the seasonal construction moratorium.

items.title: Home Sharing Program Implementation
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide an implementation plan or an intent statement regarding a municipal home-sharing program to assist seniors in aging in place.

items.title: Appropriations and Donations
items.summary: Approved $10,000 in CPA funds for an invasive plant inventory in city parks and accepted an $800 donation for veteran housing.

items.title: Police Civil Service and Board Appointments
items.summary: Tabled a request to remove police leadership from civil service and multiple board appointments to allow for further documentation and formal processes.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Entered executive session to discuss litigation strategy for Hassett v. City of Medford and adjourned.
